name: Scrapocalypse
storyline:
In 2050, a powerful corporation named ShawCorp developed a miracle cure for illness—until things went horribly wrong. Weeks after release, people began turning violent, showing aggressive behavior and attacking the uninfected. The government responded with force. In a final act of desperation, nuclear warheads were deployed by ShawCorp themselves. But the radiation only made the infected stronger and more enraged.

Now, a century later, civilization is buried in sand. Most structures lie in ruins. Only scattered survivors and horrific infected remain. It’s up to you to uncover what’s left—and decide if there's anything worth saving.
summary: Scrapocalypse is an open-world survival RPG set in a harsh post-apocalyptic desert wasteland. The year is 2150. You are a lone scavenger, covered in dust and driven by survival instinct. Roam the ruins of a decaying world, gather resources, craft tools and weapons and battle mutated the infected.
